# Scope: a country of orcs or trolls (goblins are orcs today): the Dark Lands acceptance table doubles them.
zin_dominion_is_bound_by_the_dead = {
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = zin_people_orcs
		has_country_flag = zin_people_trolls
	}
}

	OR = {
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 1 }
			date > 1750.1.1

		}

			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace = 0.75 }
			date > 1749.7.17
		}
	}
}

# Strength 70, or 60 for the historical AI after 1 Rainwake 4A 1755.
zin_volgan_great_host = {
	country_exists = Y8D
	Y8D = {
		OR = {
			check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			AND = {
				is_ai = yes
				zin_rules_is_historical = yes
				zin_dominion_after_1755_04 = yes
				check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
}

zin_volgan_may_break_veil = {
	country_exists = Y8D
	Y8D = {
		zin_dominion_after_1750_01 = yes
		check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength value = 70 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		NOT = { has_war = yes }
		NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed }
	}
}

zin_volgan_war_open = {
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
		AND = {
			country_exists = Y8D
			Y8D = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_veil_broken }
		}
	}
}

# Mirolon does not exist, or is Volgan's subject, or Volgan holds its capital and every pass state.
zin_volgan_mirolon_taken = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { country_exists = Y0Y }
		AND = {
			country_exists = Y0Y
			Y0Y = { is_subject_of = Y8D }
		}
		AND = {
			country_exists = Y0Y
			any_state = {
				zin_is_site_mirolon_seat = yes
				controller = { original_tag = Y8D }
			}
			NOT = {
				any_state = {
					zin_is_site_mirolon_passes = yes
					NOT = { controller = { original_tag = Y8D } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_volgan_body_intact = {
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed }
}

# Mirolon is gone or has yielded: a client crown can be made of it.
zin_volgan_mirolon_clientable = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { country_exists = Y0Y }
		AND = {
			country_exists = Y0Y
			Y0Y = { has_capitulated = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Volgan or one of its subjects controls a Mirolon core state.
zin_mirolon_occupied = {
	any_state = {
		is_core_of = Y0Y
		controller = { OR = {
				original_tag = Y8D
				is_subject_of = Y8D
			} }
	}
}

# Children of Volgan: body intact, Parim held, four subjects, strength 60, Eindil not crowned (world systems read it; section 13).
zin_volgan_children_ready = {
	country_exists = Y8D
	Y8D = {
		check_variable = { var = num_subjects value = 3 compare = greater_than }
		check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_strength value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	}
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned }
	any_state = {
		zin_is_site_parim = yes
		controller = { OR = {
				original_tag = Y8D
				is_subject_of = Y8D
			} }
	}
}

# Helper for the tree: Volgan's body intact, and Volgan and Zol both at war with the country that has zin_eindil.
zin_volgan_tree_compact_open = {
	country_exists = Y8D
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed }
	any_country = {
		has_character = zin_eindil
		has_war_with = Y8D
		has_war_with = Y0U
	}
}

# Helper for the tree: Volgan is at war with the controller of the Parim state.
zin_volgan_tree_at_war_for_parim = {
	country_exists = Y8D
	any_state = {
		zin_is_site_parim = yes
		controller = { has_war_with = Y8D }
	}
}

# Helper for the tree: Volgan or one of its subjects controls the Parim state.
zin_volgan_tree_holds_parim = {
	any_state = {
		zin_is_site_parim = yes
		controller = { OR = {
				original_tag = Y8D
				is_subject_of = Y8D
			} }
	}
}

# Mirolon is at war with Volgan and Volgan holds no pass state.
zin_mirolon_passes_held = {
	country_exists = Y8D
	country_exists = Y0Y
	Y0Y = { has_war_with = Y8D }
	NOT = {
		any_state = {
			zin_is_site_mirolon_passes = yes
			controller = { original_tag = Y8D }
		}
	}
}

# The Black Compact is in force (whichever event set it).
zin_dominion_compact_active = {
	has_global_flag = zin_black_compact
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_black_compact_ended }
}

# Volgan and Zol are not at war and their hosts border: the clash may begin (section 11).
zin_dominion_clash_ready = {
	country_exists = Y8D
	country_exists = Y0U
	has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches
	has_global_flag = zin_zol_rising
	NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_zol_clash }
	NOT = { Y8D = { has_war_with = Y0U } }
	Y8D = {
		any_controlled_state = {
			any_neighbor_state = { controller = { original_tag = Y0U } }
		}
	}
}
